analysis.summary: Only Phorest, Mangomint and Zenoti published anything in the last 30 days. Boulevard, Mindbody, Vagaro and Fresha were quiet, so the field is open.

points.text: Phorest is pushing multi-location med spa and aesthetic clinic software, with 29 new pages and 4 updates, which targets the same chain buyers Boulevard wants.
Mangomint published 19 new pages, 16 of them for learning: marketing ideas, templates and guides that build trust before a buyer shops.
Zenoti named two rivals in new or updated 2026 comparison pages, while Boulevard published nothing in the last 30 days.

Boulevard.play: No new or updated pages in 30 days, despite 573 pages on the site.

Zenoti.play: Head-to-head comparison pages against Vagaro and AestheticsPro, plus one awards news post.

Mindbody.play: No recent activity. Site is mostly 804 business and 215 company template pages.

Vagaro.play: No recent activity. All 193 pages sit in one /pro/ template section.

Mangomint.play: Steady flow of how-tos, idea lists, free templates and stats for salon, spa, barbershop and tattoo owners.
Mangomint.aimed: Owners learning how to run better

Phorest.play: Many near-copy pages on multi-location med spa software, marketplace costs and payment fees.
Phorest.aimed: Chains, clinics and med spas comparing options

Fresha.play: Only 3 pages on the site and no recent activity.

shared.title: Comparison pages
shared.text: Zenoti names rivals (Vagaro, AestheticsPro). Phorest compares types of tools, like marketplaces vs salon systems. Both aim at late-stage buyers, and neither targets Mindbody directly.

shared.title: Med spa and clinic focus
shared.text: Both publish for med spa and aesthetic clinic buyers, covering charting, clinical workflows and multi-location needs. Expect more rivals in Boulevard's med spa accounts.

gaps.title: Switching playbooks
gaps.text: No company in the data publishes guides for moving from Mindbody, Vagaro or Zenoti. Boulevard targets switchers, so migration steps and timelines are open.

gaps.title: Multi-location salon and spa operations
gaps.text: Phorest's chain content leans med spa and clinic. Mangomint's guides read as single-site. Group-level topics like staffing, reporting and rollout across sites are open.

gaps.title: Boulevard vs Mindbody and Mangomint
gaps.text: Zenoti compares itself only with Vagaro and AestheticsPro. No one in the data publishes a named comparison against Mindbody or Mangomint.

versus.Zenoti: Publishes few pages but aims them at buyers with named comparisons. Boulevard published nothing in the same 30 days.
versus.Mindbody: Both are quiet right now. Mindbody has 1019 pages, mostly templated business and company pages, so it adds little new editorial content.
versus.Vagaro: Both are quiet. Vagaro's 193 pages sit in one template section, so it has little editorial content to compete with.
versus.Mangomint: Far more active, with 19 new pages on teaching topics. Boulevard has no matching new content in the period.
versus.Phorest: Much more active, and aimed at multi-location buyers, Boulevard's own target. Many of its pages are near-duplicates.
versus.Fresha: Only 3 pages and no activity, so there is no content strategy to compare against Boulevard's.
